gap: No result ChatGPT got that I opened states that the Autel EVO II Dual 640T V3 Rugged Bundle airframe has no accessory interface on top of the fuselage, so Autel's RTK module, spotlight, strobe and loudspeaker cannot be added to it later; only the Enterprise Bundle and the RTK aircraft take them.
standout_why: Compared against blog.dronetrader.com/thermal-drones-for-sale, bestthermaldrone.com/best-thermal-drones, bestthermaldrone.com/compare and nighthunting.net/thermal-drones. Dronetrader prices both the Rugged and Enterprise bundles but never mentions spotlight, speaker or RTK module. Bestthermaldrone links the rugged bundle and says nothing on accessories. Nighthunting lists Rugged, Enterprise and RTK as separate rows with no compatibility text at all. I did not open the B&H compare pages, the two DJI Matrice 4 spec PDFs, nightvisionoutfitters, floridadronesupply, maverickdrone or bestthermaldrone.com/learn/thermal-drone-cost, so the claim covers only the four pages read.
decides: It settles the choice between the two EVO II Dual 640T V3 bundles Dealectric lists. The Rugged Bundle ($4,399 at autelpilot.com) is a closed configuration. A shopper who will ever need a searchlight, loudspeaker, strobe or centimetre RTK (search and rescue, night property checks, mapping) has to buy the Enterprise Bundle ($4,899) up front. The $500 saved on the Rugged Bundle cannot be made up later with the $69 to $625 add-on modules, because the airframe has nowhere to mount them. For a shopper who only wants to look at heat (wildlife, roof checks), the Rugged Bundle stands. For the EVO Lite 640T, I could not source any accessory statement, so it neither confirms nor changes that pick.
